rationales.1: The lede states the full finding with numbers, the then-and-now ink columns restate it as plain figures, and the annotated notes under the chart plus the complete table make the conclusion reachable with no chart decoding or interaction.
rationales.2: The drift chart is named by its finding, uses an honest September-to-October day scale, draws the three missing years as open bands that no average crosses, and marks 2019 as a hollow dot.
rationales.3: Gaps, the 1996 to 1997 seam, the unverified 2019 reading, and the shift-not-cause scope note are all present and repeated at every crossing point; the two-ink device makes the instrument caveat structural rather than a footnote.
rationales.4: Patient, local, and concrete throughout, with one archival fragment per ink era placed exactly where it serves the record; the prose layer is slightly thinner than the best candidate here.
rationales.5: Serif editorial typography with comfortable measure and steady rhythm holds up in both modes and both viewports; the mobile drift chart is somewhat vertically compressed.
rationales.6: The page is a fully readable linear document with no visible scroll-driven apparatus or forced pacing; motion parity itself is not observable in static renders.
rationales.7: Printed in two inks is a one-sentence signature that the stat columns, the chart, the table ink, and even the quote attributions all reinforce, and it is the data-honesty story itself.
rationales.8: One deliberate device, the ink conceit, sits on otherwise wholly conventional reading mechanics, and the About section explains the break explicitly.
rationales.9: Unsensational and specific with lines like the record keeping human time as well as rain; a touch of the register still reads as designable house style rather than one paper's only voice.
rationales.10: Every device traces to a real feature of the dataset: inks to the instrument seam, bands to the true gaps, the hollow dot to the flagged reading; nothing is decoration detached from reporting.

rationales.1: The lede carries the complete finding in prose and a what-it-shows paragraph narrates the rail in words, though a chart-averse reader has no compact then-versus-now stat surface and must lean on those two passages.
rationales.2: Values are printed on every line and the how-to-read box discloses the fixed 550 to 750 bar scale, but length-encoded bars from a nonzero baseline still visually overstate a fourteen percent rise even when disclosed.
rationales.3: Hatched no-record rows with reasons, era section headers at the instrument boundary, an inline unverified caption on 2019, and the shift-not-cause closing note cover the full honesty surface.
rationales.4: The interleaved archival quotes and the mid-record aside about the pattern becoming visible are exactly the patient local register, placed where the data earns them.
rationales.5: The rail is set with discipline and the typography carries the long read in both modes and viewports, with only minor crowding of the row figures on mobile.
rationales.6: A linear line-by-line document with no scrolljack apparatus and a fully readable base; animation behavior cannot be judged from stills.
rationales.7: Reading the record line by line like the valley almanac is a true signature, and the rightward creep of onset dots down the page makes the drift physically felt, though the compressed bar encoding slightly weakens form-as-argument.
rationales.8: The rail replacing separate charts and table is the single declared-feeling break, and everything else about the reading mechanics stays conventional.
rationales.9: Local and unsensational, with the almanac framing and valley phrasing specific enough that a competitor could not run it unchanged.
rationales.10: Every element of the rail corresponds to something the ledger actually contains, and the gaps and unverified year are rendered as themselves rather than smoothed for effect.

rationales.1: The short-version box is an explicit scannable alternative and the prose plus ledger table deliver the finding without chart decoding.
rationales.2: Gaps are drawn as gaps, the method change is a dotted line, and the truncated 550 to 750 bar axis is labeled, but the charts are small with near-illegible axis text and the storm year is highlighted without its caveat.
rationales.3: The 2019 reading of 132 millimetres is stamped with an affirmative VERIFIED badge and appears in the ledger with no qualifying note, directly falsifying the required unverified label; the other disclosures being present cannot rescue an inverted one.
rationales.4: The gardener opening and the paperwork fragments hit the local register, though headers like the hardest day in the book tip toward drama the record does not need.
rationales.5: Competent typography but small body text, undersized charts in a wide canvas, and looser polish than the other three candidates.
rationales.6: A linear readable document with no visible scroll-driven pacing or apparatus.
rationales.7: This is a well-organized article about the data rather than a form that is the journalism; no single idea binds content, visuals, and mechanics.
rationales.8: Mechanics stay conventional and nothing exceeds the break budget, but no deliberate declared break exists either, leaving it professionally plain.
rationales.9: The voice is mostly sober and local, yet the storm treatment reads more like a weather feature any paper could run.
rationales.10: The hero moment of the page, the badged 132 millimetre stat, is built on the one reading the dataset explicitly does not stand behind, which is the effect-detached-from-reporting failure this criterion exists to catch.

rationales.1: The lede gives the entire finding in numbers, every plate opens with a bold prose sentence stating what it shows, and the lettered notes plus full table make the story complete without decoding a single mark.
rationales.2: All three plates are named by their findings, the nonzero start on Plate II is declared in the title while Plate III states it is drawn from zero, gaps stay open, and 2019 is hollow and flagged in each view.
rationales.3: The seam, the three gaps, the unverified 2019 spike, and the shift-not-cause scope note are restated as marginal notes on every plate, so no view of the data ever appears without its caveats.
rationales.4: The autumn-fair line and the lane under water in October are concrete, place-loving journalism, and the two archival fragments sit exactly where they explain the numbers.
rationales.5: Assured editorial typography with comfortable measure, a disciplined plate system, and clean rendering across both modes and both viewports including full-legibility mobile charts.
rationales.6: A plain linear document with no scrolljack apparatus and a fully readable base; motion parity is not observable from static renders.
rationales.7: Reporter's notes written on the record itself is a one-sentence signature that the plate-and-marginalia apparatus, the table, and the prose all enact, and the annotation system is itself the honesty argument.
rationales.8: The plate apparatus is the single deliberate break and every reading mechanic around it remains conventional.
rationales.9: Unsensational, specific, and unmistakably local; no competitor could publish the parish and fair references unchanged.
rationales.10: Each lettered note and highlighted mark traces to a verifiable feature of the ledger, with the one dramatic reading consistently de-emphasized rather than exploited.
